content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate in any discipline with at least 2 years' experience of working with technology and software application support Experience: At least 2 years' experience of working with technology and software application support Other conditions: Candidates who are domicile of Umling C & RD Block Good oral and written communication in local language Mandatorily local candidates should be engaged Desirable: Formal training on IT/computer Worked with front line workers in any Social Development Program of Government Proven ability to successfully handle multiple tasks with a team environment Attention to detail and problem solving skills

content_sections.heading: Government of Meghalaya Block Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Block Coordinator will undertake the following duties and responsibilities in the Office of the Child Development Project Officer, Umling ICDS Project: Supporting training of AWWs and Supervisors in Information and Communication Technology enabled Real Time Monitoring(ICT-RTM) Monitoring usage of ICT-RTM by AWWs by using POSHAN Tracker and follow-up on low usage Providing in-person and over-phone troubleshooting support to users facing hardware or software problems with mobiles, tablets and basic issues with POSHAN Tracker application Logging issues in the Issue Tracker application Training reinforcement to AWWs identified as low performers using POSHAN Tracker Providing performance feedback to AWWs Submitting phones to Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for Hardware replacement and repair Escalation of issues to Block/District Coordinator via the issue Tracker application Supporting Block Level ICDS officials on usage of POSHAN Tracker Any other task as indicated by the Child Development Project Officer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of Posting: Upto 31.03.2027 On contract basis

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Government of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain application in Standard Form. Fill the form completely. Attach 2 attested passport size photographs. Attach attested copies of certificates. Attach self-addressed envelope size 4.5 x 11 cms. Submit the application to the Office of the Child Development Project Officer, Umling ICDS Project, Saiden Mawdaron, Nongpoh - 793102, Ri Bhoi District. Make sure it reaches by 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Post is for implementation of POSHAN Abhiyaan - National Nutrition Mission Scope of work includes supporting AWWs and supervisors on ICT-RTM and POSHAN Tracker
